# FLX-3634: the canonical text of a consumer query does not pass the checks again

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

The canonical text is parsed again in the duckdb dialect and passes every check of ADR 0028 section 2 once more, with the same tables, so that the tree that was checked and the text DuckDB runs are one statement. A canonical text that fails any of them, or reads other tables, is refused. The message names the check that failed.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3634
```
